Jerry Leonard, CPA, MBA, as chief financial officer, effective September 1, 2026.
Leonard succeeds Robert Dickey IV, who had served as interim CFO since August 2025.
Leonard brings more than 25 years of financial management and corporate strategy experience, including CFO roles at VSee Health and iDoc Virtual Telehealth Solutions.
